name: Shilia

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Rapid Strikes
abilities.description: Shilia casts Rapid Strikes, hitting a player multiple times and dealing multiple instances of physical damage.

abilities.name: Blood Craze
abilities.description: Shilia slashes at you twice, doing moderate physical damage over time to the player. This attack also heals the enemy over time.

abilities.name: Agony
abilities.description: The enemy stuns the player for a short time. Taking damage from any source will break the stun, but the player may choose to break free from it instead. After the stun ends, this spell also does moderate magical damage over time to the player. This spell can be interrupted to set the enemy off balance. Blocking will prevent the stun.

abilities.name: Flying Blade
abilities.description: The enemy backs away from the player and throws a dagger at the player. This attack Causes snare and bleed if it connects. This attack can be interrupted to set the enemy off balance. The dagger can be blocked to prevent the snare and bleed and reduce the damage done.

abilities.name: Steel Tornado
abilities.description: Shilia spins around, doing moderate physical damage to all players as indicated by a red circle. Blocking will reduce the damage taken.

abilities.name: Roll Dodge
abilities.description: Shilia can perform a roll dodge to avoid incoming damage.

abilities.name: Ember Explosion
abilities.description: Shilia causes a Flame damage explosion in a area.
